title: FOIA releases of thousands of UFO pages

tellings.quote: And then suddenly, thousands of pages of military failed interceptions and CIA memos and FBI investigations.

plain: From the 1970s into the early 1980s, requests under the Freedom of Information Act, a US law that lets anyone request government records, are said to have pried loose thousands of pages on UFOs: reports of failed military interceptions, memos from the CIA, the US foreign intelligence agency, and investigations by the FBI, the federal police. The researcher Richard Dolan describes this wave of releases himself, without naming a particular source. In his telling, it showed the government had been taking UFOs far more seriously than it admitted.
